cohort: The study included 120 pregnant women, divided into 60 with subclinical hypothyroidism and 60 euthyroid controls.
finding: Subclinical hypothyroidism in pregnancy was significantly associated with higher rates of gestational hypertension (35%), anemia (13%), oligohydramnios (17.5%), low birth weight (30%), NICU admissions (17.5%), and IUGR (12.5%).
